parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the data synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

*   **Forward**
*   **Reverse**

> 

*   The default value is **Forward**.

*   You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to start the reverse synchronization task only if the topology is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: SynchronizationJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the **DescribeSynchronizationJobs** operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts start-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-id dtsf19100l21860000 --synchronization-direction Forward --account-id 16897260618290000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts StartSynchronizationJob --region cn-hangzhou --SynchronizationJobId dtsf19100l21860000 --AccountId 16897260618290000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SynchronizationDirection Forward
